description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

Images and GIFs now also work in the body of link, image and video posts, new and edited. Editing a post keeps all its images (fixes a second added image deleting the first). Removed rif's outdated "cannot be edited" hint and the "Edit anyway?" popup.
Test: link post with images; edit it to add one; edit a text post twice adding an image each time.
